bio.text: According to the legislative biography, Kirstin Kahaloa represents House District 6 in Kona on Hawai'i Island and was first elected in 2022.

Before public office she worked more than a decade in international education, then served as executive director of the Kona-Kohala Chamber of Commerce and worked with organizations including Kamehameha Schools and the Blue Zones Project.
She was born and raised on O'ahu, graduated from Kamehameha Schools, and holds degrees from the University of Evansville and Webster University.
